TABLE.NAME: qtype_essaywc_options
TABLE.COMMENT: Extra options for Essay (word count) questions. Same shape as qtype_essay_options.

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key linking to the question table.

FIELD.NAME: responseformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The type of input area students should be given for their response.

FIELD.NAME: responserequired
FIELD.COMMENT: Nonzero if an online text response is required

FIELD.NAME: responsefieldlines
FIELD.COMMENT: Approximate height, in lines, of the input box.

FIELD.NAME: attachments
FIELD.COMMENT: How many attachments a student may include. -1 means unlimited.

FIELD.NAME: attachmentsrequired
FIELD.COMMENT: The number of attachments that should be required

FIELD.NAME: responsetemplate
FIELD.COMMENT: Template to pre-populate the response field.

FIELD.NAME: maxbytes
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum size of attached files in bytes.

FIELD.NAME: filetypeslist
FIELD.COMMENT: Accepted attachment file types. * or empty means unlimited.
